## 3. Detailed Technology Stack & Benchmarks

| Component | Technology | Benefit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Framework** | Next.js 15 / React 19 | Sub-second edge rendering, zero hydration lag, Partial Prerendering (PPR) |
| **Styling** | Tailwind CSS & Liquid Glass Design | Lightweight, zero-runtime CSS, modern high-prestige aesthetic |
| **Edge Compute** | Vercel Global Edge & Cloudflare | Global CDN with < 30ms Time to First Byte (TTFB) in Delhi NCR |
| **Tracking** | Server-Side Meta CAPI & Google Analytics 4 | 100% conversion signal fidelity bypassing ad blockers and Safari ITP |
| **AEO / GEO** | JSON-LD, Speakable Schema, Agent APIs | Structured specifically for ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, and Gemini citations |
| **Security** | Zero-Trust Edge Middleware | Sub-10ms prompt firewalls, automated CSRF/SSRF neutralization |

### Q: How much does website development cost in Noida, Gurugram, or Delhi NCR?
**A**: Professional web development in Delhi NCR ranges from ₹24,999 for high-speed Next.js 15 sites for startups and local businesses, to ₹49,999 for complete business growth portals with paid ads and CRM automation, and custom pricing for enterprise software architectures.

### Q: Why do businesses choose Next.js over WordPress in 2026?
**A**: Next.js sites load in under 0.8 seconds (compared to 3–5 seconds for WordPress), have zero plugin vulnerability risks, eliminate recurring database crashes, and score 99+ on Google Core Web Vitals, which directly drives higher organic Google rankings and lowers customer acquisition costs (CAC).
